answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 163937 Country: India Title: If I am in Qasr and I am offering namaz behind the Imam then how many rakats will be offered by me: 2 or 4 rakats. Question: If I am in Qasr and I am offering namaz behind the Imam then how many rakats will be offered by me: 2 or 4 rakats. Answer ID: 163937 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1244/1001/B=11/1439) Salah will be offered as per the Imam; if the imam is musafir then two rakah and if he is muqim then four rakah will be offered behind him. صلى الفرض الرباعي ركعتين (تنوير الابصار: 603) قال الحصكفي: وأما اقتداء المسافر بالمقيم فيصح في الوقت ويتم لا بعده (در مختار 2/612، زكريا ديوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
